home.hero_title: Check Any Loan App. Know the Real Interest. Fight Harassment.
home.hero_subtitle: Instant 7-day loan apps charge over 2,000% hidden interest, cut huge fees upfront, and blackmail borrowers using their contact list. Check if an app is RBI-approved, calculate actual costs, and take legal action in minutes.
home.step1_desc: Check if the app is officially partnered with an RBI-registered bank or NBFC. Spot dangerous permissions like Contacts and Photos before installing.
home.step2_desc: Got an offer for ₹5,000 but only ₹3,500 arrives in your bank? See how 'processing fees' turn a small loan into a 2,000%+ interest trap.
home.step3_desc: If agents send threatening messages or call your relatives, generate a ready-to-submit police complaint letter and protect your family.
home.sample_story: Case Story: Ramesh took a ₹5,000 loan from a 7-day app. They deducted ₹1,500 upfront as fees and gave him only ₹3,500. After 6 days, agents started calling his mother and boss with abusive messages. Using Sahukar Shield, he calculated the true 2,235% APR, generated an official Cyber Crime complaint letter, and sent our Family Protection Notice to his relatives to stop the extortion.
